scope: Private development screen; no release-wide qualification claim

recipe.precision: stored EXL3 routed experts, BF16 dense/activations/KV, FP32 accumulation
prompts: Explain how matrix multiplication uses a GPU in plain English.
Write a Python function that computes the greatest common divisor.
What is the difference between a mutex and a semaphore?
Compute 17 times 23 and explain the arithmetic.

token_equality.scope: Four prompts, 128 greedy output tokens, context 8192, C1/C4, BF16 KV, stored EXL3, default native-FP OFF; MTP+copies exercised
token_equality.hash_encoding: SHA256 of comma-separated decimal token IDs, no trailing comma

screen.interval: two-sided Student t95, df4, five round means in each fresh load; descriptive within-load variation

transport: Same named research-only LiteLLM 1.104.1 route for all generations; aggregate wall time includes router and network overhead.
